purpose: full E1 (1986) to E2 (1998) cross-era role ordering review
review_method: Exact-SHA E1 and E2 originals, role-by-role 10+10 sheet visual inspection plus comparison montages; physical technological ordering, not palette-only.

roles.physical_e1: Standard workshop steel panels, galvanized structural sections, lap plates, welded and bolted joints, simple bulkhead and louvers.
roles.physical_e2: Cleaner beige-gray electronics polymer and anodized aluminium, captured inserts and flush countersunk/precision location joints, removable chassis seams and rack/service frames.
roles.ordering_rationale: E1 1986 -> E2 1998: precision rack-service construction and reproducible mounting replace heavier workshop fabrication.
roles.comparison_completeness: all matching sheet-parts for this role, 8 specimens per sheet
roles.notes: E2 cross-era visual ordering judged from physical engineering/material/interface cues; source SHA bound. Not proof of original generator request attestation.

roles.physical_e1: Standard electric induction motors, guarded gears, hydraulics, winches, simple bearings, large pipe unions and open harness routing.
roles.physical_e2: Feedback-controlled servo/encoder drives, compact planetary and right-angle reducers, motorized linear actuators, tight guided assemblies, sealed diagnostic connector and cable systems.
roles.ordering_rationale: E1 1986 -> E2 1998: closed-loop precision servo/diagnostic infrastructure is a physical increase in sophistication, not recoloring.
roles.comparison_completeness: all matching sheet-parts for this role, 8 specimens per sheet
roles.notes: E2 cross-era visual ordering judged from physical engineering/material/interface cues; source SHA bound. Not proof of original generator request attestation.

roles.physical_e1: Relatively sparse physical pushbuttons/joystick/switches and prominently analog gauges; two isolated CRT display fragments as minority diagnostic tech.
roles.physical_e2: More compact repeatable operator modules, keypad/trackball, deepened CRT hardware, rack electronics with extractors, multipin/coax service ports, diskette media and specialized LCD as minority.
roles.ordering_rationale: E1 1986 -> E2 1998: denser electronics/service-module instrumentation, retaining physical controls but adding replaceable diagnostics.

roles.physical_e1: Bulkier incandescent-style indicator housings, early passive prismatic lenses, rotary beacons, cage/bulkhead work lights and conventional warning fixtures.
roles.physical_e2: Neutral sealed fluorescent test-center fixtures and much smaller shallow red/amber/green LED indicators, xenon strobe hardware, electromechanical fault flag and dense LED arrays/annulus.
roles.ordering_rationale: E1 1986 -> E2 1998: distinct shrink in panel indicator hardware and a visible shift from rotating/prismatic lamps to electronic strobe/LED signal modules.
